CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Replace drinking water

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

3. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

4. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.

5. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

6. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

7. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

10. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

11. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   D. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

13. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.

14. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.

15. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts Works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The number  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
